title: VirB, a transcriptional activator of virulence in Shigella flexneri , uses CTP as a cofactor
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Shigella flexneri转录激活因子VirB作为CTP依赖性DNA钳的机制，涉及TF-DNA结合与构象变化，但未采用AI或物理模拟方法，属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可迁移。
abstract: VirB is a transcriptional activator of virulence in the gram-negative bacterium Shigella flexneri . It is encoded by the large invasion plasmid, pINV, and is thought to counteract the transcriptional silencing mediated by the nucleoid structuring protein, H-NS. Mutations in virB lead to loss of virulence. Studies suggest that VirB binds to specific DNA sequences, remodels the H-NS nucleoprotein complexes, and changes DNA supercoiling. VirB belongs to the superfamily of ParB proteins which are involved in plasmid and chromosome partitioning often as part of a ParABS system. Like ParB, VirB forms discrete foci in Shigella flexneri cells harbouring pINV. Our results reveal that purified preparations of VirB specifically bind the ribonucleotide CTP. We show that VirB slowly but detectably hydrolyses CTP, which is mildly stimulated by the virS targeting sequences found on pINV. CTP and DNA binding promote VirB clamp closure. Curiously, DNA stimulation of clamp closure appears efficient even without virS sequences. These findings suggest that VirB acts as a CTP-dependent DNA clamp and may indicate that so far elusive factors might prevent offsite DNA clamping in vivo .
abstract_zh: VirB是革兰氏阴性细菌福氏志贺菌（Shigella flexneri）中毒力的转录激活因子。它由大型侵袭质粒pINV编码，被认为能抵消核样结构蛋白H-NS介导的转录沉默。virB中的突变导致毒力丧失。研究表明，VirB结合特定DNA序列，重塑H-NS核蛋白复合物，并改变DNA超螺旋状态。VirB属于ParB蛋白超家族，该家族通常作为ParABS系统的一部分参与质粒和染色体分配。与ParB类似，VirB在携带pINV的福氏志贺菌细胞中形成离散焦点。我们的结果显示，纯化的VirB制剂特异性结合核糖核苷酸CTP。我们证明VirB缓慢但可检测地水解CTP，该水解作用被pINV上发现的virS靶向序列轻微刺激。CTP和DNA结合促进VirB钳形闭合。有趣的是，即使没有virS序列，DNA对钳形闭合的刺激似乎也高效。这些发现表明VirB作为CTP依赖性DNA钳发挥作用，并可能提示迄今难以捉摸的因素可能在体内阻止非位点特异性DNA钳闭。
